Policies & FAQ

How does the deposit work?

A refundable deposit of 500,000 VND applies to each rental order, paid with the rental fee before you receive the paddle. After you return the paddles and we confirm they are in their original condition, the full deposit is refunded to the account you give at checkout. If damage occurs, we document it and charge only the actual repair or replacement cost. We never hold your original ID card or student card.

What is "Try Before You Buy"?

Buy an eligible paddle through PICKLEPASS within 7 days of your session and the 179,000 VND Compare Two Paddles fee (100%) is deducted. Your voucher shows its issue date, expiry date and status (Active / Used / Expired).

Peak and off-peak hours?

Morning: 05:00-12:00. Off-peak: 13:00-16:00. Peak: 17:00–23:00. Morning and off-peak sessions use the Off-peak price. Only genuinely available slots are offered.

How do I pay?

Bank transfer by VietQR to BIDV. Enter the exact amount and the order code as the transfer note so we can match your payment.

Corporate bookings?

Corporate packages (1,490,000 – 2,490,000 VND per session) are by quote. Tell us your headcount, number of courts, date and whether you want a match facilitator, and we confirm availability and the final price.
